title: Pip and Ned Go Fast
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new split digraphs o-e, u-e
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness), 94-sound stage (o-e, u-e just added).

pages.text: Pip and Ned get set to dash.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling lined up side by side near a hedge, ready to go.

pages.text: Pip and Ned dash past the big oak.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling racing past the trunk of the big oak tree.

pages.text: Ned is quick. Pip is quick too.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Pip the sparrow running neck and neck.
Pip the sparrow noticing a smooth round stone on the ground ahead.

pages.text: Pip stops to look at the stone.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pausing beside the path to examine the stone closely.

pages.text: Ned gets to the oak first.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling reaching a second oak tree a little ahead of Pip.

pages.text: Pip is a bit sad he did not win.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow arriving a moment later, looking a little disappointed.

pages.text: Ned grins and waits for Pip.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling grinning and waiting patiently for Pip to catch up.

pages.text: Ned and Pip sit by the oak.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Pip the sparrow sitting together beside the oak tree.

pages.text: It was fun, not just a win.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Pip the sparrow resting together happily, both content.
